I managed to contact Col. Zani's wife, telling her about the new appearance. I ran to observe and, through the binoculars, saw the light lower itself behind the same tree as before, rising again to pass over it, coming in our direction and growing in size. It descended to the ground in a dark place between the houses. Besides the light, I had the impression of seeing a yellowish, parachute-shaped object. The object must have been approximately 2

Conseguí me comunicar com a Esposa do Cor. Zani, participando o novo aparecimento. Corrí para observar, e através do binóculo, ví a luz abaixar-se atrás da mesma árvore anterior, tornando a elevar-se para transpô-la, vindo em nossa direção, aumentando de tamanho.
